Allahabad High Court Research Associates Online Form 2025 – Full Details

High Court of Judicature at Allahabad (Prayagraj) has released the notification for the post of Research Associates. This recruitment has been issued for 36 posts. Online applying process for Allahabad High Court Research Associates Recruitment 2025 has started from 15 March 2025 & the candidates can apply till 01 April 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for Allahabad High Court Research Associates Recruitment 2025 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 26 February 2025
  • Application Start Date : 15 March 2025
  • Last Date : 01 April 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 08 April 2025
  • Candidate Shortlisted for Test & Interview : 27 May 2025
  • Exam Date & Interview : July 2025
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 500/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
